text:
kline_ops: Hey team — after our recent gateway rollout the Kline private deployment shows zero datapoints in the Console for the last 48h. Charts load but read 'no data'. API calls still succeed for inference but metrics are all missing for project=kline-prod. Can you help?

sam_support: Sorry about that — I'm looking. Do you see any 4xx/5xx in the proxy logs or any auth errors from our side? Also which host is your proxy returning through?

kline_ops: Thanks. We only see successful inference responses in app logs. On the gateway we do see a couple of 401s and some requests without the X-Redwood-Tenant header. Example from our gateway access log: 
```
2026-05-12T09:13:22Z GET /v1/generate 200 - "X-Forwarded-For: 10.1.2.3"
2026-05-12T09:14:01Z GET /v1/metrics 401 - missing tenant header
2026-05-12T09:14:02Z POST /v1/generate 200 - "X-Forwarded-For: 10.1.2.3"
```
We're on on-prem gateway (envoy-nginx hybrid) doing TLS termination.

marta_support: @kline_ops can you paste a curl that reproduces the metric ingestion path? Also, is your tenant header set on the client side or injected by the gateway?

kline_ops: We rely on the gateway to inject X-Redwood-Tenant before sending to the private control plane. curl we use internally: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>" https://private.redwood.example.com/internal/metrics -d '{"m":...}'
```
No tenant header in the client. The gateway should add it.

infra-bot: Alert: 1759876543 - Missing tenant header observed for project kline-prod on private-controlplane-3 zone-a (rate 12/min)

sam_support: Looks like the gateway is stripping or not injecting on some requests (metrics vs inference differ). Two quick checks: 1) can you confirm TLS passthrough vs termination config? 2) Do you have any auth filter that rewrites headers on /internal/* paths?

kline_ops: TLS termination is at the gateway. We have an auth plugin that validates tokens and then sets X-Redwood-Tenant based on token claims. After yesterday's upgrade we rolled back a small patch but still seeing the issue.

ryn_eng_runtime: @sam_support @kline_ops this pattern (in our infra) usually happens when auth returns 401 early in filter chain and the header injection step is after auth — proxies often drop header on auth fail. Can you share a full raw request/response (with headers) for one of the 401s? If not, a packet capture around the call should show whether header was ever present.

kline_ops: Pasting raw response snippet (sanitized): 
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
content-type: application/json
cache-control: no-cache
content-length: 128

{"error":"unauthorized","reason":"missing tenant"}
```
We don't have the incoming request headers logged by default.

marta_support: Repro steps request from our side: if you can run a curl with the header explicitly (to confirm metrics ingestion path works when header present) 
```
curl -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: kline-prod" -H "Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>" https://private.redwood.example.com/internal/metrics -v -d '{"m":1}'
```
If that succeeds then it narrows to gateway injection.

kline_ops: That explicit curl returns 204 Accepted. So the control plane accepts metrics if header present.

sam_support: Good scope. So root cause likely gateway auth path & header injection ordering. Next step: can you enable debug logging on your auth plugin for a short window and share logs? If you prefer, we can run a small binary from our end to post metrics with header to show difference.

kline_ops: We'll enable debug for 15m now. Meanwhile we captured a trace: gateway auth plugin returned 401 for a short burst when token verification timed out against internal KMS. When that happened headers were not injected.

ryn_eng_runtime: That's consistent. Two action items: 1) short-term workaround: configure gateway to always forward existing X-Redwood-Tenant from an upstream sidecar (or set header in client) OR make injection occur before auth check. 2) we'll add a guard in our metrics ingest path: if request contains a valid token but no tenant header, try to parse tenant from token as fallback (requires a small runtime patch). I'll open an eng issue.

josh_oncall: I'm taking this to an incident — assigning to runtime and infra. @ryn_eng_runtime please add steps needed for a hotfix. @kline_ops can you keep debug capture running for the next hour? I'll post incident number shortly. :eyes: 

sam_support: Also setting a temporary dashboard filter: we can surface untagged metrics on a 'missing-tenant' bucket so you at least see counts while we fix. Will push to your org in 10m.

kline_ops: Appreciate it. FYI the billing side shows usage but the per-tenant charts are empty so this affects alerting.

ryn_eng_runtime: Created internal issue RNW-13421 and a tentative patch branch that adds token->tenant fallback in metrics pipeline. Pushed review request. If we can get a signed-off hotfix we can ship a patch to private control planes in next 24h.

josh_oncall: Incident RNW-INC-881 opened. Owner: josh_oncall. Priority: P2. Workplan posted to incident channel.

marta_support: Closing loop with customer: the team is on it, we've validated that explicit header works, gateway auth race is likely culprit, eng has a fallback patch + infra config workaround. Will follow up when hotfix is scheduled. :thumbsup:

kline_ops: Thanks everyone — we'll keep debug logs open and will roll gateway change if you confirm. Please ping when RNW-13421 is ready for testing.

sam_support: Will do. I'll update this thread with the hotfix ETA. Thanks.
